title: Kaaviya Thalaivan
desc: Two rival artists at Sivadas Swamigal's drama troupe compete in everything they do. While one of them goes on to become successful, the other fails in life.

title: Kannum Kannum Kollaiyadithaal
desc: Siddharth and Kalli never seem to be short on money. However, when they meet the women of their dreams, they are pushed into reconsidering their career choices.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, who once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces and chart out an inspirational path of freedom against the despotic rulers.

title: It'S My Life - Seetha
desc: A young Ram is left in a monastery by his uncle with a promise that Sita will come for him and take care of him. Years later, he is ecstatic when he meets Sita.

title: Raatchasi
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Geetha Rani implements different plans to reform an undisciplined government school. However, she faces numerous challenges in her way, including a corrupt MLA.

title: Eeram
desc: Vasu vows to uncover Ramya's killer after he stumbles upon her corpse in an apartment. However, as more murders occur, he learns that Ramya's vengeful spirit is behind the killings.
